institution.name: Bais HaMedrash and Mesivta of Baltimore

plan.notes: Institution-published four-year course map from the official 2023-2024 Academic Catalog: each Fall/Spring semester = Talmud In-Depth (7 cr) + Talmud Survey (5 cr) + Jewish Law (1 cr) + Jewish Philosophy (1 cr) + Bible (1 cr) = 15 cr; 8 semesters = 120 cr. Catalog: 'The course of study leading to the Bachelor's of Talmudic Law (BTL) consists of a minimum of 120 credits in Talmud and Judaica. Of the 120 required credits, 96 credits in Talmud are core requirements, 24 are taken as electives. These electives include 8 Bible credits, 8 Jewish Law credits and 8 Jewish Philosophy credits.' Level rule: 'First and second year students may register for 100 and 200 level courses. Advanced level courses are required of third and fourth year students by the start of the third academic year.' Catalog's 'Eight courses ... taken one per semester' lists do not assign specific elective courses to specific semesters; semester options follow the catalog's numbering sequence. Talmud slot options are intentionally empty: the catalog assigns specific TAL courses 'at the discretion of the Dean' from the year-level choose-from lists quoted verbatim in each choice_note. Note: AARTS's September 2025 accredited-programs list names this school's degree 'Bachelor of Talmudic Studies'; the school's own official 2023-2024 catalog calls it 'Bachelor's of Talmudic Law (BTL)' and the catalog is followed here.

courses.title: Talmud In-Depth (intensive sugyot)
courses.choice_note: First year students choose from TAL201, 202, 203, 204, 205, 206, 207, 208, 209, 210, 211, 212, 213, 214, 225, 226, 227, 228, 229, 230, 231, 232, 233, 234, 235, 236, 237, 238. Intensive courses study sugyot in Talmud, self contained topics in Jewish law which interrelate tractates in Talmudic literature. These courses are also tracked by level and are assigned seven contact credit hours. The major consists of 96 credits in Talmud. The specific distribution of courses and requirements are at the discretion of the Dean, although the courses generally cycle, one Tractate per year, through all of the offered Tractates.

courses.title: Talmud Survey
courses.choice_note: First year students choose from TAL201, 202, 203, 204, 205, 206, 207, 208, 209, 210, 211, 212, 213, 214, 225, 226, 227, 228, 229, 230, 231, 232, 233, 234, 235, 236, 237, 238. The survey courses typically cover not less than 35 folios of Talmud per semester. These courses earn five credits each based upon contact hours with faculty. The major consists of 96 credits in Talmud. The specific distribution of courses and requirements are at the discretion of the Dean, although the courses generally cycle, one Tractate per year, through all of the offered Tractates.
